corrections.old_text: ሕር ፥⟫ ማቴ ፬ ፲፮ ሉቃ ፭ ፪ ፥
corrections.corrected_text: ሕር ፥⟫ ማቴ ፬ ፲፰ ሉቃ ፭ ፪ ፥
corrections.reason: The cross-reference for the calling of Simon and Andrew by the Sea of Galilee is Matthew 4:18 (ማቴ ፬ ፲፰), and the printed numeral clearly shows the two vertical chambers of ፰ (8) rather than ፮ (6).
Both the printed glyph on line 35 and Classical Ge'ez orthography from the root ምህረ (cf. ይምህሮሙ on line 32 and ይሜህሮሙ on line 38) use ህ (ምህሮቶ) rather than ሕ.
